title: China sentences official to death for spying, leaking national secrets
description:
A Chinese official has been sentenced to death for spying for a foreign country, a government-linked publisher said on Monday.
Gold Wall Press, a publishing company associated with China's National Administration of State Secrets Protection, said the convicted person was surnamed Ma and was approached and recruited by a foreign intelligence service while working abroad.
Chinese courts typically do not publish information about state security cases, but in recent years the powerful Ministry of State Security and Gold Wall Press have increasingly publicised arrests as well as using social media, movies and comics to promote warnings about espionage.
The statement said Ma signed a cooperation agreement containing clauses on "confidentiality" and "loyalty" and received fixed monthly payments. In total, it said, he provided 35 pieces of information that were classified as national secrets and received payments worth over 1 million yuan (USD 1,50,000).
